scripts.preneu:dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='http://localhost:5173'; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.neu:dev: npm run preneu:dev && concurrently -k "npm run dev" "neu run"
scripts.preneu:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='/'; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.neu:build: npm run preneu:build && npm run build && neu build --release
